acceptance.content:

You must provide accurate information during registration. One person may only have one account. Sharing accounts is not permitted.

Player statistics and skin data are fetched from public DDNet APIs. We do not control the availability or accuracy of this data.

termination.content:

Upon termination, your right to use the platform ceases immediately.
